ruleDefinitions.name: Dump Credentials from Windows Credential Manager With PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may search for common password storage locations to obtain user credentials.
Passwords are stored in several places on a system, depending on the operating system or application holding the credentials.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-PasswordVaultCredentials.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-CredManCreds.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-Object.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Windows\\\.Security\\\.Credentials\\\.PasswordVault.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-Object.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.CSharp\\\.CSharpCodeProvider.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[System\\\.Runtime\\\.InteropServices\\\.RuntimeEnvironment\\]\\:\\:GetRuntimeDirectory\\(\\)\\).*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Collections\\\.ArrayList.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*System\\\.CodeDom\\\.Compiler\\\.CompilerParameters.*")))
